statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low after Monday showed substantial mean reversion; current NQ price discovery is unavailable during the scheduled CME maintenance break.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. The next material checkpoint is Tuesday’s 12:30 UTC Empire State release followed by the U.S. cash open, with re-escalation conditional on renewed one-way extension and failed retracements.
headline: Tail returns to low after intraday repair; cross-asset stress remains extreme
body: The Nasdaq closed 0.56% lower after recovering substantially from deeper opening weakness, showing meaningful mean reversion before a late second leg. The PHLX semiconductor index fell 5.9%, the 10-year Treasury yield briefly exceeded 5%, and Brent settled at $105.68. NQ is currently in the scheduled CME maintenance break, so no live futures path is asserted for this hour.

lookbackSummary: Tail moved from low on Sunday evening into WATCH/elevated overnight and premarket risk, peaked around 31-32% through the late morning and cash open, then fell as the U.S. session produced meaningful mean reversion. The 20:00 UTC close-hour assessment returned to WATCH at 22% after a late second leg.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is low during the CME maintenance break. Conditional risk rises modestly at the 22:00 UTC Globex reopen and more materially around Tuesday’s 12:30 UTC Empire State release and 13:30 UTC cash open, but remains below the block threshold unless fresh one-way structure and failed retracements emerge.

forecast.analysis: Current Tail is low after Monday produced substantial mean reversion from the opening selloff, although a late second leg left the Nasdaq down 0.56%. Live NQ price-path evidence is unavailable during the scheduled CME maintenance break; severe semiconductor losses, 5% Treasury yields and $100-plus oil keep Stress extreme.
drivers: Monday cash trading showed meaningful mean reversion despite a late second leg.
PHLX semiconductors fell 5.9%, with Nvidia, Micron, Broadcom and AMD all sharply lower.
The 10-year Treasury yield touched 5% while Brent settled at $105.68.
CME NQ is in the scheduled 17:00-18:00 ET maintenance break, so live structure is unavailable.

news.title: Wall Street ends down, calls for AI slowdown pummel chipmakers
Oil settles higher after Saudi strikes stoke supply worries

forecast.analysis: At the Globex reopen, Tail moves to WATCH only as a conditional reopening-risk premium. Persistent extension of the late cash-session weakness with shallow pullbacks would validate it; quick overlap or gap repair would favor a return below 20%.
drivers: Globex reopens at 22:00 UTC after the daily CME maintenance break.
Late cash-session weakness is a conditional continuation checkpoint, not proof of future one-way structure.
Oil, yields and semiconductor weakness remain cross-asset amplifiers if NQ fails to retrace.

news.title: Wall Street ends down, calls for AI slowdown pummel chipmakers
Oil settles higher after Saudi strikes stoke supply worries

forecast.analysis: If the reopened futures market develops two-way overlap rather than repeated extension, Tail returns to low. Oil, yields and chip weakness remain background stressors, but this hour needs fresh price-path failure before they justify a higher path-risk score.
drivers: Reopened NQ overlap or gap repair would confirm retracement capacity.
Repeated extension after failed pullbacks would be the main Tail escalation signal.
Elevated oil and rates remain stress context rather than standalone Tail proof.

news.title: Oil settles higher after Saudi strikes stoke supply worries

forecast.analysis: Early Asian trading is modeled with low Tail because Monday already demonstrated meaningful retracement capacity. A renewed directional gap with failed pullbacks would invalidate that assumption; otherwise high cross-asset Stress can coexist with low Tail.
drivers: Asian-session liquidity can expose overnight gap risk.
Monday’s large intraday repair argues against assuming persistent mean-reversion failure.
Fresh one-way structure would override the low-Tail baseline.

news.title: Oil settles higher after Saudi strikes stoke supply worries

forecast.analysis: This hour remains low-Tail under the condition that overnight NQ continues to rotate rather than hold persistently near a session extreme. Semiconductor weakness and elevated oil still support extreme Stress, not an automatic Tail block.
drivers: Overnight session-extreme holding would be the relevant invalidation.
Semiconductor weakness remains a persistent backdrop.
Oil above $100 keeps macro Stress elevated.

forecast.analysis: The forecast shifts toward normal structure if Asia remains orderly and retracements continue to occur. Tail would need fresh one-way efficiency or aligned cross-asset re-acceleration to move materially above this low baseline.
drivers: Orderly Asian rotations would support normal structure.
Cross-asset re-acceleration would matter only if NQ structure aligns.

forecast.analysis: Before Europe becomes the main liquidity center, the base case stays low Tail. A sharp overnight extension that cannot retrace would be the relevant invalidation; absent that, the prior U.S. session’s large intraday repair remains the stronger path signal.
drivers: Pre-Europe liquidity is thinner than the U.S. cash session.
A no-retracement overnight extension would raise Tail; ordinary drift would not.

forecast.analysis: Tail stays low into the European pre-open if overnight structure remains overlapping. The score does not assume that Monday’s semiconductor or oil pressure has disappeared; it assumes those stressors have not yet produced a new mean-reversion failure.
drivers: European pre-open transition can widen short-term volatility.
Two-way overnight structure would keep Tail low.
Persistent session-extreme holding would be a stronger warning than daily sector losses alone.

forecast.analysis: European pre-open liquidity modestly raises uncertainty, but Tail remains low unless futures establish a directional break with shallow recovery attempts. Cross-asset pressure is treated as an amplifier only if fresh NQ structure aligns with it.
drivers: Europe pre-open raises transition risk without a scheduled U.S. catalyst.
Directional break plus shallow pullbacks is the key conditional escalation pattern.

forecast.analysis: Around the European open, Tail remains low under an orderly-transition assumption. A one-way move that holds near overnight extremes would raise concern, while sustained two-way rotations would reinforce the low-Tail classification.
drivers: European cash open adds liquidity and cross-market price discovery.
Sustained two-way rotations would confirm retracement capacity.
Aligned yields, oil and semis amplify only if NQ becomes directionally efficient.

forecast.analysis: As European price discovery matures, the forecast keeps Tail just below WATCH if NQ continues to retrace directional pushes. Persistent semiconductor weakness may raise Stress, but does not by itself establish a pathological price path.
drivers: European morning structure becomes more informative for the U.S. premarket handoff.
Semiconductor weakness remains Stress evidence, not automatic Tail evidence.

forecast.analysis: The late-European morning is expected to remain low Tail unless U.S. index futures begin repeated extension without meaningful pullbacks. The approaching U.S. data window starts to matter more for Stress than for Tail at this stage.
drivers: Approaching U.S. premarket increases sensitivity to rates and equity-index futures.
No scheduled Tier-1 U.S. release occurs in this hour.

forecast.analysis: Tail remains low before the main U.S. event window. The score assumes no new one-way structure has appeared; any fresh alignment of yields, oil and semiconductors with failed NQ retracements would be the primary escalation trigger.
drivers: U.S. premarket liquidity rises ahead of Tuesday data.
Fresh failed NQ retracements would be required for a stronger Tail signal.

forecast.analysis: Entering the U.S. premarket, Tail reaches WATCH as event and opening sensitivity increase. The risk is conditional: persistent extension must be observed before the known Tuesday checkpoints can be treated as a path failure rather than generic volatility.
drivers: Event proximity increases short-horizon whipsaw risk.
Empire State Manufacturing Survey is scheduled for 12:30 UTC.
No release outcome or reaction is assumed in advance.

forecast.analysis: With the Empire State release approaching, Tail stays in WATCH while Stress rises. No release outcome is assumed. A surprise matters for Tail only if subsequent NQ trading becomes directionally efficient with shallow or failed retracements.
drivers: Empire State Manufacturing Survey is 30 minutes away at the start of this hour.
Event importance primarily raises Stress before observed post-release price structure exists.
Rates and oil remain potential amplifiers if NQ becomes one-way.

forecast.analysis: The 12:30 UTC Empire State release sits inside this hour, so Stress is very high and Tail is WATCH. The forecast is conditional on the post-release path: orderly retracement can keep Tail contained, while repeated extension would raise it.
drivers: Empire State Manufacturing Survey is scheduled at 12:30 UTC.
The post-release path, not the release label alone, determines Tail escalation.
U.S. cash open follows at 13:30 UTC.

forecast.analysis: The U.S. cash open occurs at 13:30 UTC, keeping Tail near the top of WATCH. An opening auction that extends the premarket move with shallow pullbacks is the main risk; an early reversal or deep retracement would argue against escalation.
drivers: U.S. cash open is scheduled at 13:30 UTC.
Opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks is the main Tail checkpoint.
A deep opening retracement would argue against a pathological path.

forecast.analysis: The first full cash-session hour remains the peak WATCH slot. Tail stays below the block threshold unless the opening move repeatedly extends after failed retracements and holds near session extremes with cross-asset confirmation.
drivers: First full cash-session hour is the main opening-structure checkpoint.
Repeated extension after failed retracements would justify escalation.
Session-extreme holding plus aligned cross-assets would be a stronger Tail signal.

forecast.analysis: After the initial cash discovery, Tail eases if the market develops two-way rotations. Continued one-way extension from the open would invalidate that easing and keep the path risk near the upper WATCH band.
drivers: Post-open two-way rotations would reduce path risk.
A delayed continuation leg remains conditional rather than assumed.

forecast.analysis: Mid-session Tail falls toward the lower WATCH boundary under a stabilization assumption. Persistent pressure in chips, yields or oil matters most if NQ stops retracing; otherwise those factors primarily sustain high Stress.
drivers: Mid-session liquidity can favor mean reversion after opening discovery.
Persistent one-way NQ structure would invalidate the expected Tail easing.

forecast.analysis: By late morning in New York, Tail returns to low if earlier event and opening moves have been meaningfully retraced. A delayed second leg remains possible, but it is not treated as observed in advance.
drivers: Observed retracement capacity would support a return to low Tail.
The broader oil-rates-semiconductor backdrop can keep Stress extreme.

forecast.analysis: Early afternoon remains low Tail provided price discovery stays two-sided. The score leaves Stress extreme because the broader catalyst stack is unresolved, while requiring fresh failed retracements before raising Tail.
drivers: Early afternoon is modeled as lower path risk if rotations persist.
A fresh catalyst-aligned directional leg would require reassessment.

forecast.analysis: Power-hour sensitivity lifts Tail back into WATCH conditionally. A late-session second leg with repeated extension and shallow pullbacks would be the relevant path risk; ordinary closing volatility without mean-reversion failure would not.
drivers: Power hour is a known checkpoint for late-session continuation or reversal.
A second leg with shallow pullbacks would raise Tail; ordinary closing volatility would not.

forecast.analysis: Into the cash close, Tail remains WATCH but below the block threshold. The score is conditional on whether any late move preserves retracement capacity; a clean directional close near an extreme with failed pullbacks would warrant reassessment.
drivers: Cash-close structure determines whether late directional pressure retains retracement capacity.
The next day’s FOMC sequence remains outside this 24-hour forecast horizon.

forecastDetail.comment: Current low Tail reflects substantial Monday mean reversion; live NQ structure is unavailable during CME maintenance while cross-asset Stress remains extreme.
At the Globex reopen, WATCH is conditional on whether late cash weakness extends with shallow pullbacks or instead repairs quickly.
Tail returns below WATCH if reopened futures show overlap and retracements; failed pullbacks would invalidate that easing.
Early Asia remains low Tail unless a fresh directional gap develops without meaningful retracement.
Low Tail persists if overnight NQ avoids sustained session-extreme holding despite the unresolved semiconductor and oil backdrop.
Normal structure is favored if Asian trading remains two-sided; aligned one-way NQ and cross-asset pressure would raise Tail.
